name: Indonesian Film Festival
theme: Temaram: The Unwavering Glow of Indonesian Cinema
themeSubtitle: In a time marked by political, economic, and social uncertainty, cinema offers a window through which we can find hope, connection, and perspective. Temaram represents the gentle glow that persists even in moments of darkness. As a reflection of human stories, Indonesian cinema captures the struggles, dreams, and resilience of its people, illuminating the unwavering spirit of Indonesians and reminding us that even in uncertain times, our stories, and our hope, continue to shine.
